_meta.description: Free zone knowledge base. Drives free-zone ranking, cost breakdown, and visa-quota assessment in the deterministic engine. Edit this file to update pricing/rules; do not embed zone facts in code.
_meta.pricing_disclaimer: All figures are APPROXIMATE publicly-advertised package pricing for 2026, cross-checked in August 2026 against multiple business-setup consultancies and (where published) the zone authorities. They change frequently and are sold mostly through agents, so bands overlap and promotions vary. Figures exclude some real-world extras not always bundled (name reservation, deposits, activity add-ons, VAT, health insurance). Always confirm a live written quote with the zone authority or a licensed corporate services provider before relying on any number.

field_docs.specializations: Activity categories this zone is known for. Matched against activity.categories for ranking.
field_docs.setup_cost_aed: Approx. first-year cost for a basic licence WITHOUT visas (min-max band). Low end = cheapest 0-visa / subsidised package; high end = premium or industrial licence.
field_docs.annual_renewal_aed: Approx. yearly renewal for the licence (min-max band).
field_docs.per_visa_cost_aed: Approx. ALL-IN cost per additional employment/investor visa (min-max band) — typically entry permit, medical, Emirates ID and residency stamping. Excludes the Establishment/Immigration card, which is a one-off ~AED 2,000-2,500 per company.
field_docs.visa_rules.flexi_desk_max_visas: Max visas typically allocated on a flexi-desk / shared-desk or virtual-office package with no dedicated office.
field_docs.visa_rules.sqm_per_visa: Rule-of-thumb dedicated office space (in sqm) required per additional visa once beyond the flexi-desk allocation.
field_docs.prestige: Relative brand prestige of the address (low | medium | high), used only as a tie-breaker.

free_zones.name: IFZA (International Free Zone Authority)

visa_rules.notes: 0-visa licence from ~AED 12,900; packages bundle visa slots (1 visa ~14,900, 3 ~19,900, 6 ~26,900). A one-off Establishment Card (~AED 2,000-2,500) applies on top.

pros: Low cost with a Dubai address
free_zones.source: IFZA published package pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: SHAMS (Sharjah Media City)

visa_rules.notes: Among the cheapest entry points — licence from ~AED 5,750 (0-visa); an all-inclusive 1-visa media/e-commerce package runs ~AED 14,990. Base package is visa-light, best for freelancers/solo media businesses.

pros: Strong fit for media/creative and freelancers
cons: Thin visa allocation on base package
free_zones.source: SHAMS published package pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: Meydan Free Zone

visa_rules.notes: All licence types from ~AED 12,500/yr including a virtual-office address and up to 3 activities; visas ~AED 3,500 each, up to 6 per licence. Establishment Card ~AED 2,000 extra.

pros: Good for e-commerce and general trading
Virtual office included in base package
free_zones.source: Meydan Free Zone published package pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre)

visa_rules.notes: Licence from ~AED 15,000-20,000 for a standard setup (e-commerce/freelance from ~7,500). Virtual-office ~1 visa, flexi-desk ~2; higher counts need a dedicated DMCC office in JLT/Uptown (executive offices AED 45,000-90,000+). Visas ~AED 4,500 all-in.

pros: World's most-awarded free zone; strong brand
cons: Premium pricing once you add a real office
free_zones.source: DMCC published package pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre)

visa_rules.notes: Subsidised Innovation Licence for tech/AI/Web3/fintech is ~USD 1,500/yr (~AED 5,500). A full startup setup with flexi-desk and 2 visas runs ~AED 93,000-103,000; regulated financial firms need leased office and DFSA approval.

cons: High cost for regulated/standard commercial firms
free_zones.target_company_size: Funded fintech and financial institutions (plus subsidised tech startups)
free_zones.source: DIFC published pricing / Innovation Licence, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market)

visa_rules.notes: Tech Startup Licence ~USD 1,500/yr (~AED 5,500), subsidised up to 3 years; non-regulated commercial from ~AED 15,000; standard commercial/financial ~USD 4,000-12,000+. Commercial licence fees were cut >50% from 2025.

pros: Subsidised Tech Startup Licence; recent fee cuts
cons: Abu Dhabi base may not suit Dubai-centric teams
free_zones.target_company_size: Funded fintech, asset managers, financial institutions (plus subsidised tech startups)
free_zones.source: ADGM published pricing / Tech Startup Licence, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: Dubai Internet City (TECOM)

visa_rules.notes: Licence from ~AED 15,020 (plus business-plan approval ~2,000 and registration ~3,510). Specialised licences (e.g. cybersecurity) start higher (~AED 30,000). Larger visa counts need a leased TECOM office.

cons: Best value only if you use the ecosystem
free_zones.source: TECOM / Dubai Internet City pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: RAKEZ (Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone)

visa_rules.notes: Biz Starter 0-visa from ~AED 5,499; +1 visa with flexi-desk ~AED 12,900; trading/media packages ~AED 15,000-18,000. Renewals ~AED 6,000 (0-visa) to ~18,000; Biz Starter has a 3-year price lock. Industrial land/warehousing available cheaply.

pros: Low cost for both services and industrial
cons: Ras Al Khaimah base (further from Dubai)
free_zones.source: RAKEZ published package pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: DAFZA (Dubai Airport Free Zone)

visa_rules.notes: Service licence from ~AED 10,000, commercial ~15,000, industrial ~20,000. Cheapest all-in Year-1 package ~AED 22,040. Establishment Card ~AED 2,020; visas ~AED 4,000-5,000. Visa scaling tied to leased office/warehouse area.

pros: Excellent for logistics, re-export and trade
free_zones.target_company_size: Trading and logistics firms with cargo needs

free_zones.name: Dubai South Free Zone

visa_rules.notes: Professional/starter packages from ~AED 12,500 (some from ~8,500); 1-visa package ~AED 19,000. Most SMEs land at ~AED 18,000-30,000 for Year 1 with one investor visa. Visas ~AED 4,000-6,000 all-in.

pros: Aviation/logistics corridor around Al Maktoum airport
Good value for e-commerce and warehousing
Room to scale into industrial land
cons: Ecosystem still maturing vs central zones
free_zones.source: Dubai South published pricing, cross-checked Aug 2026 (approximate)
